title: A test: one cauldronback (120 hull) at Eltanin Prime Belt, Node Beta; alloy scale into storage
note: 2026-11-17 08:14 UTC (Apophis): a test with one ship of prey above 100 hull (F9: Military tests bigger prey, one ship).
